purpose: Teach: 泙/蹐/癲/腓/磴/曚/儖/蕁

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新工場の水利、つまり水音、泙の影響評価をせよ
lines.en: I want a proper environmental impact assessment for water usage at the new factory.
lines.style: Crisp, measured delivery. Authoritative but not harsh. Clear enunciation on the key terms. Expects compliance without needing to emphasize it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。下請けが跼蹐、つまり蹐になり過ぎない様、対等に接します
lines.en: Understood. We'll work with the subcontractors as equals, making sure they're not overburdened.
lines.style: Methodical, reassuring tone. Steady pace. Shows he's already thought this through. Professional but not distant — this is how things will be done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の癲癇、つまり癲歴のある方への合理的配慮を整えろ
lines.en: Make sure we have proper accommodations in place for any staff member with a history of epilepsy.
lines.style: Direct, no-nonsense. Clear authority in each phrase. Delivered as a non-negotiable standard, not a suggestion. Slight emphasis on 'proper.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。長時間作業の腓腹筋、つまり腓の疲労対策をおこないます
lines.en: Yes. We'll strengthen fatigue protocols for long shifts, especially for leg strain from extended standing.
lines.style: Confident, measured response. Demonstrates thoroughness without over-explaining. Shows preparation. Steady eye contact implied in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、工場敷地内の磴、つまり石段を改修しろ
lines.en: And have the stone steps and walkways on the factory grounds renovated.
lines.style: Casual command, almost conversational in its certainty. Not harsh — just matter-of-fact. Brief and final, moving to the next point.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。夜勤の曚、つまり曚気時の照明を強化します
lines.en: Understood. We'll upgrade the lighting for night-shift areas to prevent fatigue and accidents.
lines.style: Responsive and efficient. Shows he's tracking the intent behind each request. Clear, professional tone. Demonstrates he'll anticipate the next concern.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の儖、つまり儖の体型データを健康診断で記録しろ
lines.en: Have health check-ups include recorded body composition data for all staff members.
lines.style: Clinical, matter-of-fact delivery. Organizational and precise. Delivered as standard procedure, not personal intrusion. Slight emphasis on 'recorded.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の蕁麻疹、つまり蕁の発症時にすぐ対応します
lines.en: Understood. We'll have immediate response protocols in place for any staff members who develop allergic reactions or hives.
lines.style: Attentive closer. Shows care embedded in competence. Warm but professional. Final confirmation — the meeting is complete, the standards are set.
